node.name: Google: recent investments and cohorts
node.description: Required every run: several Google searches for the firm's recent investments and cohort announcements. Hits are leads, verified later.

inputParameters.name: query
inputParameters.description: e.g. '{{"Company Domain"}} mentions in the news'

inputParameters.name: numberOfResults
inputParameters.description: Number of results to pull. Defaults to 5. Maximum is 10.

inputParameters.name: language
inputParameters.description: Language to use for search (defaults to English)

inputParameters.name: country
inputParameters.description: Country to use for search (defaults to United States)

inputParameters.name: includeResultCount
inputParameters.description: If switched on, the approximate result count from Google will be added to the returned data. This number is an approximation. Using operators like "site:" in your query help make this number more accurate.

inputParameters.name: includeAds
inputParameters.description: If switched on, Ad results will be included in the returned data.
